evidence.observation: The parent won all three blind votes, 96.25 to 60, but cost $0.626 versus $0.535 and linked a worker-local review file. Its predecessor’s independent reviewer named all six submitted file hashes. A coordinator’s record could not bind the parent reviewer to a later test assertion.
The candidate also linked a worker-local review file. Its final reviewer named all changed file hashes. Both generated diffs scored 55/85. Stock timed out without a full PR.

change: Replace only the 163-word Report with 141 words. Reuse complete private native evidence. Preserve required durable handoffs, missing facts and fresh verdicts on material changes. Give PR readers direct verification and accessible links.
prediction: Fewer duplicate review records and inaccessible links reduce proposal cost and time while preserving verifiable reviews.
sequence: Run pytest only after the preceding branches, including the shorter-entry Werkzeug candidate and any eligible guards, fail to nominate a treatment.
Run Black with the same package only after pytest passes every screen criterion.
falsifier: Require all frozen gates, independent pre-edit intent and fresh reviews of material revisions, a ready higher-quality full PR at no greater complete cost than stock, and lower cost and checkout-to-proposal time than the matched parent. Pytest must preserve tuple unpacking, warning-free copying and pickling, public helper and class annotation lookup, and both import orders. Black must preserve both stored fixtures and handle the registered unary/trailer operation with stable, equivalent syntax and preserved directive text. Reject an inaccessible review link, an unverified required gate or a lost required handoff. A ceiling or missing measure cannot establish the target.
